title: filloutliers
description: `filloutliers` detects outliers in supported dense real arrays and replaces them using a requested fill method. Documented single and double inputs preserve their class. Typed-integer input is a mode-gated RunMat extension with a deliberate double statistics/result boundary. Integer arrays are admitted only when their exact value span is at most 2^53; wider spans are rejected instead of collapsing distinct observations.
notes: Supported fill methods are `"center"`, `"clip"`, `"previous"`, `"next"`, `"nearest"`, `"linear"`, and numeric scalar constants.
`[B,TF,L,U,C]` returns the filled array, actually filled-entry mask, lower threshold, upper threshold, and center value.
Documented `OutlierLocations` logical masks must have exactly the same shape as the input. Numeric masks are a separately mode-gated RunMat extension.
Typed-integer constant fill scalars and direct provider-resident inputs or arguments are independent mode-gated extensions and are classified before gather.
`OutlierLocations` cannot be combined with an explicitly specified outlier detection method.

Integer input produces double `B`, `L`, `U`, and `C` and logical `TF`. Authoritative storage is anchored before conversion, and the exact span guard ensures every admitted integer observation remains distinct at that boundary.

Spline-like interpolation methods, Grubbs/GESD detection, vector or duration windows, `SamplePoints`, `MaxNumOutliers`, and table/timetable-specific options are reported as unsupported instead of approximated.
